title: Dispensed days' supply and the adherence adjustment on Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewals
content:
**To dispensing pharmacies — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewals.**

The adherence adjustment follows the days' supply dispensed on the prescription in the last 6 calendar months: 170 to 190 days adds 1 fill; more than 190 days takes away 1 fill; under 170 days changes nothing.

**What is added up.** The days' supply of every dispensing of this prescription whose dispensing date falls within the 6 calendar months before the renewal date, whatever its dispensing basis. Authorizations and voids are not dispensings.

| Days' supply dispensed in the 6 months | Adherence adjustment |
|---|---|
| under 170 | no change (0) |
| 170 to 190, both included | adds 1 fill |
| more than 190 | takes away 1 fill (-1) |

**Edges (hypothetical).** 169 days dispensed: no change. 170 days: adds 1 fill. 190 days: adds 1 fill. 191 days: takes away 1 fill.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Six dispensings of 30 days in the 6 months total 180 days: adds 1 fill. Seven such dispensings total 210 days: takes away 1 fill.
